precision: float64 observation/signature arithmetic; retained float32 raw/spectral tensor and pool storage; float64 graph features and ridge/scaling

boundaries.archive_loading: Warm OS-cache original loader, all 10299 windows plus labels, subjects and supplied561 (unused); excludes splitting and numerical work
boundaries.observation_preprocessing: Finite-input check, triad formation/differences, fit or apply axis means/stds and triad RMS, geometric streams/cosines
boundaries.feature_extraction: FFT/normalization and spectral summaries, requested signature/graph/pool blocks, QR plans, coordinate assembly; no trained weights
boundaries.feature_scaling: Training constant-column mask and unweighted StandardScaler fit/transform, or frozen mask/transform
boundaries.ridge_fit: Balanced targets/centering/weights, Gram formation, alpha10 LU solve, intercept; excludes StandardScaler
boundaries.prediction: Scaled feature-matrix multiplication, intercept, argmax only
boundaries.total: Sum of the four corresponding timed stages; train excludes archive loading and validation selection; apply includes preprocessing through prediction

implementation_scope: Single requested model; retains rf.spectrum helper's pooled-summary computation even when compact discards that pool. No deployment kernel optimization. Reference generation and correctness checks are outside timing.
timing_scope: Wall-clock warmed process, five sequential repeats, one numerical thread, no accelerator, no enforced CPU affinity or exclusive host reservation; min/max describes timing variation, not accuracy uncertainty.
selection_budget: No new selection. Saved comparison chose between two frozen models at alpha10 using validation; five deterministic seeds and companion heads were historical checks, not independent accuracy samples.
